item.title: ‘Please don’t do that’: Brentwood releases footage of officers shoving woman into patrol car, where she passed out before death
item.description: The death of Yolanda Ramirez, not disclosed by police until after the media found out, has led to public controversy and dueling autopsy reports.

item.title: Isolation adds to burdens for older people
item.description: As aging experts declare loneliness a public health crisis, programs like Meals on Wheels offer older adults more than food.

item.title: By spotlighting disabled performers, Bay Area company AXIS Dance challenges conventional thinking about movement
item.description: The group's unique exploration of dance – pioneering different ways to translate internal thoughts, feelings and ideas into physical motion – started as a therapeutic way to regain bodily autonomy.

item.title: War powers debate intensifies after Trump orders attack on Iran without approval by Congress
item.description: The Constitution gives Congress the power to declare war.

item.title: Prep girls basketball playoffs: Third-quarter woes doom Benicia in championship game
item.description: The Matadors outscored Benicia 20-4 in the third quarter and never looked back, cruising to a 57-47 victory and their first NCS crown since 2017

item.title: Trump’s ‘America First’ campaign battle cry gives way to military strikes abroad
item.description: Trump’s decision to strike Iran pulls him toward the kind of conflict he once attacked.

item.title: Prep girls soccer playoffs: Benicia’s season ends in extra time heartbreaker
item.description: After scoring a late equalizer to send the North Coast Section Division IV championship match to extra time, the Panthers conceded an own goal in stoppage time of the second overtime period to suffer a heartbreaking 3-2 loss to Terra Linda.

item.title: Solano County congressional reps decry strikes on Iran
item.description: Solano County’s two Democratic congressional representatives issued statements Saturday decrying President Trump’s announced strikes on Iran, sharply criticizing the decision to launch military action without congressional authorization and warning of serious risks to U.S. troops and regional stability.
